items.title: Jerry Dodgion interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, March 9, 1996

ctx.x: Well Flip called him Pops because he called everybody else Pops. And you know it’s like Louis Armstrong called people Pops but he was Pops. But when he’d talk to you he’d say, “Hey Pops you want to do this?”
Yeah, well he says that. Yeah, that’s right.
